en: The rest of us stayed out all night
lang: baaki asi saari raat bahar rahe

en: At three in the morning we ate parathas
lang: raat de tin baje asi parathe khaye

en: We watched the sunrise at India Gate
lang: asi India Gate te suraj nikalda dekheya

en: We were very tired but very happy
lang: asi bahut thake si par bahut khush si

en: On Saturday we all slept a lot
lang: Saturday nu asi sab bahut sutte

en: We woke up at three in the afternoon
lang: asi dupehar de tin baje uthe
